data.description:
Surfaced by Copilot review on PR #21. The new plugins/dso/scripts/fix-cascade-recovery/reset-cascade-counter.sh is exercised end-to-end by tests/hooks/test-cascade-breaker.sh but has no focused unit test.

Scope: add tests/scripts/test-reset-cascade-counter.sh that:
- Runs the script in a temporary git repo
- Asserts /tmp/claude-cascade-<hash>/counter is created and contains '0'
- Asserts last-error-hash is removed if pre-existing
- Asserts exit 0 + safe no-op when not in a git repo

Reference: PR #21 review comment 3164683373.
data.title: Add unit test for reset-cascade-counter.sh
